name: Instrumented original Vilverin fresh food-sack loot

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = false

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local done=false
local before={{}}
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at original food sack')
 local chest=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6c2ad))
 if not chest or not chest:isValid() then return end
 if not done then
  local inv=Actor.inventory(self)
  for _,id in ipairs({{0x3365d,0x23d89,0x33666,0x33668,0x3366b,0x33680,0x33681,0x3368b,0x3368a,0x3368c,0x33690}}) do
   local key=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id)
   before[key]=inv:countOf(key)
   print('VilverinSackLoot before item='..key..' count='..before[key])
  end
  done=true
 end
 local added=0
 local player=Actor.inventory(self)
 for key,count in pairs(before) do
  local delta=player:countOf(key)-count
  assert(delta>=0 and delta<=4,'Original food quantity outside authored draw bounds')
  added=added+delta
 end
 assert(added<=4,'More food than four authored independent draws')
 if added>0 then print('VilverinSackLoot concrete transfer quantity='..added) end
 local aim=chest:getBoundingBox().center
 local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim)
 local angle=math.atan2(p.x,-p.z)
 local elevation=-math.atan2(p.y,math.sqrt(p.x*p.x+p.z*p.z))
 local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),aim,{{ignore=self}})
 local range=(aim-camera.getPosition()):length()
 local limit=core.getGMST('iMaxActivateDist')+camera.getThirdPersonDistance()
 local invView=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local direction=(invView:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-camera.getPosition()):normalize()
 local centerRay=nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),camera.getPosition()+direction*limit,{{ignore=self}})
 if range<limit-20 then print('VilverinSackLoot within range') end
 if math.abs(angle)<.005 and math.abs(elevation)<.005 and ray.hitObject and ray.hitObject.id==chest.id then
  print('VilverinSackLoot facing sack')
  if centerRay.hitObject and centerRay.hitObject.id==chest.id then
   print('VilverinSackLoot ready target='..tostring(chest)..' range='..range..' limit='..limit..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
  end
 end
 print('VilverinSackLoot center target='..tostring(centerRay.hitObject)..' range='..range..' limit='..limit)
 print(string.format('VilverinSackLoot look x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(elevation*256+.5)))))

end}}}}
